reserved_final_panel.name: MagFace
reserved_final_panel.checkpoint_status: Downloaded from the pinned author's Google Drive link with gdown to Downloads/FCKFACE-data/heldout-models; hashed, not loaded or evaluated.
reserved_final_panel.preprocessing: Use five-landmark 112x112 alignment to the linked InsightFace template. Official feature extractor reads aligned crops with cv2.imread (BGR), ToTensor scales to [0,1], Normalize(mean=0,std=1) leaves values unchanged; horizontal flip is generated but the recognition feature path uses the unflipped input. Do not substitute RGB or [-1,1] normalization.
reserved_final_panel.artifact_terms: Checkpoint is linked by the author, but no separate weight/data redistribution terms verified; keep local and unpublished.

reserved_final_panel.artifact_terms: Checkpoint is in the author's repository; no separate training-data or model-artifact rights determination has been made. Keep local and unpublished.

reserved_final_panel.name: TransFace

reserved_final_panel.preprocessing: Official inference.py reads BGR with cv2, resizes to 112x112, converts to RGB, then float32 CHW (value/255 - 0.5)/0.5. Its model-facing inference example assumes a face crop; the separate ModelScope example uses RetinaFace, largest-face selection and alignment. Exact detector/alignment policy for this checkpoint remains to be frozen before calibration.
